instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: If you take things more seriously, will you earn more? Or do you start taking things more seriously after you earn more? When you hear about studies on income and personality, you may expect to learn the secret of people who earn a lot, but this time, the people in the story are not rich people. They are your past self and your later self. The research brought together 11 large studies. They looked at people who had jobs and shared information about their personality and work income. The number of people was not the same in every study. The researchers used data from up to 134,515 people. Each study measured the same people's income and personality at least three times. The important thing was how the researchers compared people. They looked separately at differences between people that usually stay the same. They also looked at changes inside each person.
